description: Bind a Gitlawb DID (Ed25519 did:key) to a 0x wallet via MUTUAL proof so LAWBOR reputation attaches to the DID. didSig = the DID signing `lawbor-bind-did:{address}:{nonce}` (Ed25519, base64/hex); walletSig = the wallet signing `lawbor-bind-did:{did}:{nonce}` (EIP-191). One DID ↔ one wallet (anti-sybil).

didSig.description: Ed25519 sig (base64 or hex) over lawbor-bind-did:{address}:{nonce}.

name: lawbor_bind_did
